questions.question: Estimate 8 432 ÷ 124, then work out the exact answer.
questions.expected_answer: Estimate: 8 400 ÷ 120 = 70. Exact: 124 fits into 843 six times (744), leaving 99. Bring down 2 to make 992, which is 124 × 8. The answer is 68.

questions.question: Work out 5 000 ÷ 135 and check your answer.
questions.expected_answer: 135 fits into 500 three times (405), leaving 95. Bring down 0 to make 950; 135 × 7 = 945, leaving 5. The answer is 37 remainder 5. Check: 37 × 135 = 4 995, and 4 995 + 5 = 5 000.

questions.question: Why is 6 150 ÷ 205 equal to 30 and not 3?
questions.expected_answer: 205 fits into 615 three times exactly. Then the 0 is brought down, and 205 fits into 0 zero times, so a 0 is written in the units place of the answer. The answer is 30. Check: 30 × 205 = 6 150.
